description: Flat metadata schema for one sequenced tumor specimen from a cancer patient, including consent, clinical context, biospecimen handling, sequencing workflow, quality metrics, and somatic alteration results.

record_id.descr: Unique identifier for the metadata record or sequenced specimen.

patient_id.descr: De-identified patient identifier linking the record to the originating patient within the study.

study_participant_id.descr: Optional study-specific participant code if different from patient_id.

consent_obtained.descr: Whether informed consent for genomic analysis and data sharing was obtained from the patient.

consent_date.descr: Date when informed consent was obtained.

consent_scope.descr: Controlled description of allowed uses, e.g., research only, clinical return of results, data sharing, international sharing.

ethical_approval_id.descr: Institutional review board or ethics approval identifier governing sample collection and sequencing.

privacy_level.descr: Data access category, e.g., open, controlled access, restricted clinical use.

primary_diagnosis.descr: Cancer diagnosis or histopathologic tumor type, preferably using a controlled vocabulary.

primary_site.descr: Anatomical primary site of the tumor, e.g., lung, breast, colon.

histology_type.descr: Histologic subtype of the tumor, if known.

tumor_stage.descr: Clinical or pathological stage at sampling, e.g., TNM stage or localized/advanced/metastatic.

biopsy_date.descr: Date the tumor biopsy or resection specimen was collected.

specimen_type.descr: Type of biospecimen, e.g., biopsy, resection, FFPE block, frozen tissue, blood-derived normal control.

specimen_site.descr: Anatomical site from which the tumor tissue was obtained.

specimen_preservation.descr: Preservation method used for the specimen, e.g., fresh frozen, FFPE, RNAlater.

tumor_content_percent.descr: Estimated percentage of tumor cells in the input specimen or extracted material, in percent (%).

necrosis_percent.descr: Estimated percentage of necrotic tissue in the specimen, in percent (%).

microdissection_performed.descr: Whether microdissection or tumor enrichment was performed before extraction.

dna_extraction_method.descr: Method or kit used for DNA extraction from the tumor tissue.

dna_input_amount_ng.descr: Amount of DNA input into library preparation, in nanograms (ng).

dna_quality_metric.descr: DNA quality metric used in the study, such as A260/280, DIN, or fragment length; report the value in a standardized textual/numeric form if needed.

collection_date.descr: Date the biospecimen was collected, if different from biopsy_date.

sample_processing_date.descr: Date on which the specimen was processed for DNA extraction or library preparation.

processing_time_hours.descr: Time between specimen collection and processing, in hours.

sequencing_center.descr: Laboratory or core facility that performed sequencing.

library_preparation_kit.descr: Library preparation kit or protocol used for sequencing.

library_type.descr: Library strategy, e.g., whole genome, whole exome, targeted panel, amplicon.

capture_panel.descr: Target enrichment panel name, if applicable.

sequencing_platform.descr: Sequencing instrument/platform, e.g., Illumina NovaSeq, NextSeq, PacBio, Oxford Nanopore.

sequencing_read_length_bp.descr: Read length in base pairs (bp), if applicable.

sequencing_layout.descr: Sequencing layout, e.g., single-end or paired-end.

mean_depth_coverage_x.descr: Mean sequencing depth over the targeted region or genome, in fold coverage (x).

target_bases_covered_percent.descr: Percent of target bases covered at or above the study-defined minimum depth threshold.

base_quality_threshold.descr: Base quality threshold used for downstream analysis or filtering.

mapping_reference_genome.descr: Reference genome build used for alignment, e.g., GRCh37/hg19 or GRCh38.

alignment_tool.descr: Software used for read alignment to the reference genome.

duplicate_marking_performed.descr: Whether PCR duplicates were marked or removed during preprocessing.

variant_calling_tool.descr: Software used to call somatic variants.

somatic_snv_count.descr: Number of somatic single-nucleotide variants identified for this specimen.

somatic_indel_count.descr: Number of somatic insertions and deletions identified.

copy_number_alteration_present.descr: Whether clinically or analytically relevant copy-number alterations were detected.

structural_variant_present.descr: Whether structural variants or rearrangements were detected.

fusion_detected.descr: Whether a gene fusion or rearrangement fusion event was detected.

actionable_variant_present.descr: Whether one or more variants were considered potentially clinically actionable.

top_driver_gene.descr: Most important driver gene altered in this specimen, if identified.

top_variant_hgvs.descr: Primary variant annotation in HGVS-like notation, if applicable.

variant_classification.descr: Controlled classification of the main alteration, e.g., missense, nonsense, frameshift, CNV gain, CNV loss, fusion.

variant_allele_frequency.descr: Observed allele fraction for the main somatic variant, expressed as a proportion from 0 to 1 or as percent if standardized by the study; specify consistently.

clinical_significance.descr: Interpretive clinical significance of the main alteration, e.g., pathogenic, likely pathogenic, VUS, resistant, predictive.

treatment_at_sampling.descr: Therapy the patient was receiving at or near the time of sampling.

prior_treatments.descr: Summary of prior cancer treatments before specimen collection, e.g., surgery, chemotherapy, targeted therapy, immunotherapy, radiation.

response_to_previous_treatment.descr: Clinical response category to previous therapy, if available.

sample_collection_to_report_days.descr: Turnaround time from specimen collection to genomic report generation, in days.

report_returned_to_clinician.descr: Whether the genomic findings were returned for clinical decision-making.

data_release_date.descr: Date the record or genomic results were made available to researchers, if applicable.

file_format.descr: Primary data file format, e.g., FASTQ, BAM, CRAM, VCF, MAF.

file_checksum.descr: Checksum for the primary data file, such as MD5 or SHA256, to verify integrity.
